This app seems to do only two things:
1) it measures your pulse with your phone’s camera. 
2) it lets you record your blood pressure MANUALLY in the app. 
If you have an Apple Watch, this app adds nothing!

I’m disappointed and disputing the credit card charge because the app doesn’t do much at all for $29.99 per year!

Your app is an absolute fake and all you have been doing is keep on charging for unauthorized subscription fee.
I’m now filling a written complaint to the state attorney’s office for the fraudulent business practice and absolute fraudulent advertisement.
I have been requesting the refund of so called
